name: zbj-mcp
description: Zhubajie (deals): me, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_zbj_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_zbj_app_key.description: appKey (应用证书) of your approved ZOP application (open.zbj.com > 控制台).

platform_mcp_zbj_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_zbj_app_secret.description: Application secret (应用密钥); signs every call as uppercase hex SHA1 of secret + sorted name/value pairs + secret. Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_zbj_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_zbj_access_token.description: accessToken (访问令牌) from the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation of your 猪八戒 account.

platform_mcp_zbj_openid.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZBJ_OPENID
platform_mcp_zbj_openid.description: Your 猪八戒 openid (the user identifier returned by the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation), used by zbj.user.getUserBaseInfo.

tools.name: me
tools.description: zbj.user.getUserBaseInfo (openid): nickname, userName, avatarPath, openid of the authorised account.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: zbj.task.getDetailById (taskId): the 需求 with title, content, mode (1 比稿, 2 招标, 3 众包), employer nickname, amount (budget, CNY), hostedAmount, createTime (epoch seconds), remainTime (seconds), worksAvailableNum, category ids, milestones and attachments (in raw).
